Added optional date support to `habit done`:

- `src/streak.js:8-13` — new `parseDateArg(token, now)` helper: recognizes `"today"`, `"yesterday"`, and `YYYY-MM-DD`, returns `null` otherwise.
- `src/cli.js` — when `done` is invoked with more than one arg, the last arg is checked against `parseDateArg`; if it's a valid date token, it's split off as the date and the rest is joined as the habit name (`habit done read yesterday`, `habit done read 2026-09-01`). Otherwise all args are treated as the name, preserving multi-word habit names like `habit done deep work`.
- `test/streak.test.js` — added tests for `parseDateArg`.

`done()` in `commands.js` already accepted a `today`/date parameter, so no changes were needed there. All 9 tests pass.

Note: I couldn't manually exercise the CLI binary in this session (shell command approval was denied with no prompt surface available), so verification relied on the automated test suite rather than a live run.
